newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland bans heavy truck movement from July 2. [CORRECTED 14:10 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Poland bans heavy truck movement from July 2. [CORRECTED 14:10 GMT]

text.p: Poland banned heavy truck movement between 11 a.m to 11 p.m (corrects local time from 10 a.m. and 10 p.m.) (0900 and 2100 GMT) from July 2 until further notice to limit damage to roads during a heat wave, official media said on Monday.
Daytime temperatures have been exceeding 30 Celsius.
PAP news agency quoted a statement by the head of Poland's public roads, Tadeusz Suwara, as saying the ban would affect all trucks weighing more than 12 tonnes.
